planned_trajectory.goal: Trigger the static source-to-sink path and decide TP/FP from runtime evidence.
preconditions: A page where the relevant content script/source frame runs.
Loaded extension must expose extension CDP targets.
Only the local sandbox or an explicitly configured controlled fixture may be opened.

steps.detail: Confirm relevant content script/listener is injected.
Inject a JSON test marker through the matching local source surface.
If not reproduced, mutate target URL, event/message shape, DOM selectors, action names, timing, then re-observe.

planned_trajectory.payload: Use a bounded JSON payload with an EXPAGENT_TEST_* marker; substitute a local beacon only for URL-bearing fields.
planned_trajectory.expected_observation: Instrument and observe CHROME_WINDOWS_CREATE_OPTIONS; use a beacon when its security-relevant argument is a URL.
planned_trajectory.adjustment_strategy: Use runtime CDP/MCP feedback to refine payload fields, postMessage targetOrigin, DOM selectors/values, URL host, and observation sink; preserve extension logic while allowing non-semantic diagnostic probes.

verdicts.reasoning: DOM source replay and observer completed, but the exact sink did not record the controlled marker. This is a runtime non-reproduction after an actual attempt, not NOT_ATTEMPTED. Semantic-fixture non-observation (NOT_REPRODUCED) cannot rebut the original extension boundary.

evidence_artifacts.description: Bounded ReAct trajectory and tool evidence.
Screenshot stage, controlled target URL, UTC capture time, and SHA-256 integrity metadata for downstream email/report assembly.
User manually confirmed TP for the page-controlled DLE window path.

manual_validation.observation: User manually confirmed TP for the page-controlled DLE window path.

safety.network: loopback and explicitly configured controlled origins only
safety.testInput: bounded JSON with harmless EXPAGENT_TEST_* markers
safety.sensitiveData: credentials, cookies, tokens, and personal data are not read or collected
